name: obsidian-letterhead
description: Generate professionally formatted business letters (DIN 5008 and modern) from note frontmatter and export them to PDF — via the print dialog on desktop, or the system share sheet on iPhone and iPad.

scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:pure && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "${OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR:?set OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR}"/
